definitions: Having the joy and vitality associated with younger people, despite one's own advanced age.

entries.title: Young at Heart (Johnny Richards and Carolyn Leigh song)

blocks.text: "Young at Heart" is a pop standard ballad with music by Johnny Richards and lyrics by Carolyn Leigh.
Restless is the debut studio album by Australian band Amy Meredith released on 2 July 2010. The album debuted on the ARIA Albums Chart at number eight and spent seven weeks in the ARIA top 50.

"Young at Heart" is a song by the English pop group Bananarama from their debut studio album, Deep Sea Skiving (1983). The song was later recorded by the Scottish band the Bluebells, whose version reached the top of the UK singles chart after a re-release in 1993.

At Heart is the third studio album by American metalcore band Miss May I. The album was scheduled for release on May 29, 2012, but delayed to June 12, 2012. At Heart generally received positive reviews, noting the "mature" shift in sound with the band. The first single released from it was "Hey Mister" along with its accompanying music video.
